basic_details.job_title: Gujarat University Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Assistant Professor Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Gujarat University (GU) has officially announced the Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 with 2 openings. The detailed notification has been published on the official website, https://www.gujaratuniversity.ac.in. Candidates holding a Master's degree with a minimum of 55% marks along with NET/SLET/SET qualification or a Ph.D. are eligible to apply online up to 05 August 2026. Direct links to download the notification and apply online are shared below.

qualification.education_qualification: Master’s degree with Minimum 55% marks, NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D.
qualification.details: Assistant Professor - International Relations: A Master’s degree with Minimum 55% marks in International Relations or English (or equivalent) from an Indian University or accredited university. Must have cleared NET conducted by UGC/CSIR or similar test like SLET/SET or awarded Ph.D. Ph.D. is mandatory if NET/SLET/SET not conducted for the discipline. Assistant Professor - Diaspora and Migration Studies: A Master’s degree with Minimum 55% marks in Diaspora and Migration Studies or English (or equivalent) from an Indian University or accredited university. Must have cleared NET conducted by UGC/CSIR or similar test like SLET/SET or awarded Ph.D. Ph.D. is mandatory if NET/SLET/SET not conducted for the discipline.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Gujarat University to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Gujarat University Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Gujarat University Assistant Professor positions is 05 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Assistant Professor posts at Gujarat University. These are distributed across two specialized fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree with a minimum of 55% marks, along with NET/SLET/SET qualification or a Ph.D. degree in the relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Professor posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 60,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for Gujarat University recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these Assistant Professor roles?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor positions at Gujarat University will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor positions at Gujarat University are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where is Gujarat University located?
faq.answer: Gujarat University is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, with the pincode 380009.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Gujarat apply for these positions?
faq.answer: The notification mentions inviting applications from eligible candidates in Gujarat. However, for definitive information, it is best to refer to the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website for Gujarat University careers?
faq.answer: The official website for Gujarat University careers, where you can find more information and potentially apply, is https://www.gujaratuniversity.ac.in/career.
